events.verdict: Jackson (MEM) makes legal hand on ball contact at the end of Queen's (NOP) drive.
Queen (NOP) is bracing for the contact from Jackson (MEM) as they come together at the end of the drive, and the contact that occurs as Queen releases away is marginal.
Jackson (MEM) plants his foot as a help defender and makes incidental foot to foot contact with Queen (NOP) as he moves through the lane.
Williamson (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Spencer (MEM) as the steal occurs.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes legal hand on ball contact blocking Queen's (NOP) shot attempt near the rim.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) goes to, not through, Queen's (NOP) space and the contact is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) and Jones (NOP) make mutual marginal contact with one another in the post.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) initiates contact with Williamson's (NOP) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Queen (NOP) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Williamson (NOP) brushes Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm as he pursues the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Williamson (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Coward (MEM) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the drive.
Jones (NOP) directly contests Landale's (MEM) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Landale's hand after the release.
Jackson (MEM) initiates contact with Murphy III's (NOP) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Jackson (MEM) defends Murphy III (NOP) during the drive and makes incidental contact with Murphy as a trapped is set.
Jackson (MEM) commits a take foul on Murphy III (NOP).
